summary: Fractal UI Details accepts per-field pending durations and host-supplied provenance or guard reasons, shown in each value's tooltip instead of repeated beneath values. Resource sections on their first read stay visible as skeletons rather than appearing unavailable. The Subagents badge shows the reported traced total, known-zero traced sessions and empty observed resource lists are shown as evidence, traced titles show role, model and session id, and long reported spend windows wrap at narrow widths.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Additive optional fields: DetailsDisplayObservation.pending/detail and DetailsSection.pending. Hosts that omit them still see the presentation changes: the Subagents badge shows the reported total instead of the retained row count; a Subagents section with an observed empty list or a reported zero traced count stays visible and shows that evidence; traced titles read role (or role unreported), model and session id, wrap, and no longer repeat the model in the detail line.
